render_api: render_i(fig, rect), rect=(left,bottom,width,height) in normalized figure coordinates; returns Axes
scientific_question: Which sampled EE angle balances three patient-summary errors, and how stable is the ranking to within-run sampling?
subject: epilepsiae_1146

aggregate.name: Mean display error
aggregate.justification: All three errors are absolute discrepancies of quantities on [0,1]; equal component weights are an explicit post hoc display convention, not a fitted or historically optimized loss.
aggregate.shaft_weighting: Equal SCL/ICL weight within each component; contacts or within-shaft pairs equally weighted within a shaft.
aggregate.mean_rank: Absolute difference of conditional mean normalized within-event ranks, averaged across contacts within each shaft, then across shafts.
aggregate.order: Absolute difference of P(t_j>t_i)+0.5 P(t_j=t_i), conditional on joint participation; averaged within each shaft, then across shafts.
aggregate.participation: Absolute difference of event participation probability, averaged within each shaft, then across shafts.

uncertainty.kind: Paired nonoverlapping physical-time-block bootstrap, model side only
uncertainty.resampling_unit: All qualified model events within one 4.5 s block of the same trajectory
uncertainty.inferential_unit: One simulated network/noise realization at each angle; NOT 13 independent networks
uncertainty.fixed_reference: 19770 patient FIT events summarized once, no patient resampling
uncertainty.displayed_band: Original full-sample L_display plus/minus one bootstrap SD; not a confidence interval
uncertainty.variance_definition: sample variance over recomputed aggregate scores; all component covariance retained
uncertainty.pairing: Same drawn physical-time-block indices across all angles; no event-index pairing
uncertainty.assumptions: Post-burnin blocks treated as exchangeable; block-length sensitivity recorded. Longer dependencies and nonstationarity are not identified from one 60 s run.
uncertainty.limitations: Does not estimate independent seed/topology variance, patient sampling uncertainty, or independent validation error.

optimum.uniqueness: Empirical argmin on the sampled grid, not a unique population optimum; inspect paired gap and block sensitivity.
optimum.no_variance_penalty_selected: Variance has squared-error units. No unrequested tradeoff coefficient is imposed to force one robust optimum.

optimizer_contract.J: Equal mean of calibrated signed D_off terms: rank_pattern, local_and_interrod_timing, participation; full distribution features, not these three display MAEs.
optimizer_contract.J_joint: Joint event-cooccurrence objective from a later stage; unavailable for this frozen scan.
optimizer_contract.panel_C_integration: If C retains optimization best-training loss, label C as Training loss J and I as Display error. A common C/I definition requires recomputing one entire series, not relabeling.
